> [!NOTE]
> **Claude Code port** of [`third_party/squarespace/`](../../../third_party/squarespace/), generated by [`Claude/scripts/build.mjs`](../../scripts/build.mjs). Change `Claude/scripts/port.config.mjs` or `Claude/overrides/`, not this folder.
>
> Install: `/plugin marketplace add <path-to-repo>/Claude`, then `/plugin install squarespace@cursor-plugins-claude`.

# Squarespace for Claude Code

Public domain naming/search tools can be used without authentication. Show sponsored labels, first-year and renewal prices, and distinguish an unknown available:null result from unavailable. A checkout link is not a purchase. Commerce is separately client-qualified through CIMD; do not claim native Commerce tools or replace CIMD with DCR.

Install from the native marketplace described above. Use the actual provider sign-in or exposed public read tools; static package validation does not prove native OAuth, entitlements, or live behavior. Do not copy Cursor/Grok account or credential flows.
